ownerAcceptance.proposedText: Approve global-code-next-boundaries-2026-11-09 as one exact claim-reviewed, append-only batch with scope SHA256 a2622375de0b06ae716dcfeda26b87e68a66b2a72183a0393e8c255cd847ff5b: the 32 listed IATA/ICAO boundary-only assignments and their 16 linked physical identities, subject to unchanged formal validation and identity conflict review. Preserve unknown outer endpoints, day-level uncertainty, separate IATA/ICAO timing and HAL/Devanahalli site identities. Accept the county retrospective August18 statement as executed operator code use, not IATA allocation-ledger custody. This is one central exact-batch acceptance, not per-airport approvals, an automatic policy grant, a continuity rule, a copyright licence, merge or release authorization.

rightsBasis.access: MoCA policy permits downloads meant for download. Its reproduction restriction is recorded, not treated as an open licence.
rightsBasis.basis: Copyright Act1957 section52(1)(q)(i), statute text hosted by intergovernmental WIPO Lex legislation390852. Gazette S.O1170(E)/S.O1181(E) are statutory notifications, not an Act of a Legislature.
rightsBasis.excluded: No AAI grant inheritance, concession fulltext licence, chart/photo/contract reproduction or blanket government licence.
rightsBasis.permittedProjectUse: Atomic BLR transfer fact and necessary short Gazette citation only. Retrospective concession letter supplies atomic commissioning corroboration without reproducing its contractual text.

rightsBasis.basis: LexUZ ZRU42 article8 official-document exclusion, scoped to national permanent AIS administrative code change and officially issued controlled identifiers. Article5 protects expression and article7 compilations; no blanket fact/whole-AIP licence asserted.
rightsBasis.excluded: No AIP charts, full tables, translations, layout or full document redistribution.
rightsBasis.issuerScope: GEN0.1 documents designated AIS under Civil Aviation Agency authority; D0968 and AIRAC05/25 supply effective permanent national change.
rightsBasis.permittedProjectUse: Atomic code/site/change-day facts and minimal anchors only.

rightsBasis.basis: 17USC105/101 as explained by Government Publishing Office: official-duty federal employee authored work.
rightsBasis.excluded: Third-party charts/material remain excluded; county work does not inherit federal status.
rightsBasis.permittedProjectUse: Only authored federal administrative text and atomic code facts with attribution.

rightsBasis.basis: Feist499US340 at344–351: facts are not copyrightable; expression and original compilation remain protected.
rightsBasis.issuerScope: County operator is primary for its executed airport code use; it is not the IATA allocation ledger custodian.
rightsBasis.permittedProjectUse: Atomic operator-reported executed code-use boundaries and bibliographic metadata; no wholesale FAQ extraction or county licence asserted.

rightsBasis.basis: Reuse the specifically locked legacy b5 AAI site-name facts and the pinned OurAirports public-domain snapshot for reference attributes. Existing source-specific metadata treatment is preserved; no AAI code policy or licence is extended to MoCA.
rightsBasis.family: IN-AAI-AIP and PUBLIC-DOMAIN-REFERENCE identity support only
rightsBasis.permittedProjectUse: Physical-site attribution/display/reference coordinates only; not historical allocation or continuity.
